value.name: Rosa explains the desk had been disturbed
value.description: Rosa tells Asha she knew someone had been in the desk before her but did not know who.
evidence: Rosa looked at Asha very steadily. "I knew that someone had been in the desk before me. I did not know who."

value.name: Rosa suspects funeral home workers
value.description: Rosa says she thought the funeral home staff might have been the ones in the room, citing their early arrival and the younger worker's time alone in the hallway.
evidence: "I thought it might be the funeral home — they had come for the body at four in the morning and one of them, the younger one, had been alone in the hallway for several minutes while I was downstairs."

value.name: Rosa fears a child entered the room
value.description: Rosa admits she feared one of the matriarch's children had come into the room while she was downstairs.
evidence: "That one of her children had come into the room while I was downstairs."

value.name: Asha senses Daniel's attention
value.description: Asha avoids looking at Daniel but feels the intensity of his attention in the quiet hallway.
evidence: The hallway behind them was very quiet.
Asha did not turn to look at Daniel. She did not need to. She could feel the temperature of his attention the way a person feels a radiator coming on in a cold room.

value.name: Asha thanks Rosa
value.description: Asha acknowledges Rosa's information and the conversation moves on.

value.name: They search the third-floor office
value.description: Asha and Rosa continue to the third floor, where an old office remains mostly intact despite the matriarch's inability to climb there for years.
evidence: They went on. The third floor, where the matriarch had not climbed in eight years on account of her knee but where a small office had once been kept and had been left more or less intact.

value.name: Rosa opens the filing cabinet
value.description: Rosa opens a filing cabinet in the old office to inspect its contents.

value.name: Asha finds old records in the cabinet
value.description: Asha sees that the cabinet contains outdated folders and records, including tax returns, warranty cards, and Daniel's school report cards.
evidence: Inside were folders, manila and green both, none of them recent.
A binder of warranty cards for appliances long since replaced.
A folder of school report cards for Daniel from 1979 through 1985

value.name: Daniel reacts to the report cards
value.description: Asha senses Daniel's deep exhale as Rosa lifts aside his school report cards, suggesting he fears they might be read aloud.
evidence: which Asha glimpsed only briefly as Rosa lifted it aside
which she thought afterward might have been the moment when Daniel exhaled most deeply, as if he had been afraid Rosa was going to take that folder out of the cabinet and read aloud from it.

value.name: They fail to find a codicil
value.description: The search of the cabinet turns up no green folder containing anything like the codicil they are looking for.
evidence: There were no green folders containing anything resembling a codicil.
